content.value_statement: SpecDD projects can be hard to interpret when rules are spread across bootstrap files and specs. This skill explains the active contract in plain language without editing files.
actual_capabilities: Explains the purpose and scope of a SpecDD spec.
Identifies relevant bootstrap and spec chain context.
Separates direct requirements from reasonable inference.
Summarizes boundaries, dependencies, and completion criteria.
Preserves important SpecDD terms such as Must and Must not.
Avoids file edits unless the user asks for a change.
limitations: Requires an existing SpecDD project with a bootstrap file.
Does not create, adopt, or modify SpecDD specs by default.
Depends on available project files for accurate explanations.
Does not replace legal, compliance, or architecture review.

use_cases.title: Explain a Feature Spec
use_cases.description: Summarize what a feature spec requires before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Review Contract Boundaries
use_cases.description: Clarify allowed changes, forbidden behavior, and write authority for a target area.

use_cases.title: Understand Project Rules
use_cases.description: Translate bootstrap and governing specs into a concise project contract summary.

prompt_templates.title: Explain This Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the SpecDD spec for this target in plain language. Separate requirements from inference.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single spec explanation.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Change Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the active SpecDD boundaries for this change. Include allowed edits, forbidden edits, and open questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a scoped implementation or review.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Spec Chain Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how the bootstrap files and governing specs combine for this target. Highlight rules that narrow earlier rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Understanding a multi-file effective spec chain.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Spec Interpretation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my interpretation of this SpecDD contract. Identify unsupported claims, missing references, and risky assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation before implementation or approval.

output_examples.input: Explain the SpecDD rules for the billing workflow.
output_examples.output: The billing workflow spec controls behavior, boundaries, and completion criteria. Direct requirements are listed separately from inferred implementation guidance.

output_examples.input: What can I change in this module under SpecDD?
output: Allowed changes: items explicitly covered by the nearest governing spec.
Restricted changes: behavior outside the stated scope or without write authority.
Open points: unclear ownership or missing references that need confirmation.

output_examples.input: Check whether my summary matches the active spec chain.
output_examples.output: The summary matches the main requirement but treats an inference as a rule. The uncertain point should be labeled before implementation.

best_practices: Provide the target file, feature, or behavior you want explained.
Ask for direct requirements and inferred guidance as separate sections.
Request exact references when decisions depend on contract wording.
anti_patterns: Use it to edit specs without explicitly requesting a change.
Ask for broad project analysis when one governing spec is enough.
Treat inferred behavior as a confirmed SpecDD requirement.

faq.question: What does this skill explain?
faq.answer: It explains SpecDD specs, target behavior, active boundaries, and effective spec chains.

faq.question: Does it modify project files?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for explanation and should not edit files unless you explicitly ask.

faq.question: What project setup does it require?
faq.answer: It expects an existing SpecDD project with a root bootstrap file.

faq.question: Can it explain multiple specs together?
faq.answer: Yes, when the active spec chain or explicit references make multiple specs relevant.

faq.question: How does it handle unclear requirements?
faq.answer: It labels missing context, underspecified behavior, and reasonable inference separately.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
